name: diffusion-ddpm-from-scratch
primer:
Conventions: PyTorch tensors, batch-first. The noise schedule arrays (betas, alphas, alpha_bars)
have shape (T,); gather_at_timesteps indexes them by a (B,) timestep tensor and returns (B,1) so
the terms broadcast over the data. The model predicts the NOISE added to a sample (epsilon
parameterization); the training loss is MSE between predicted and true noise.
Every other function in this project is also available in your namespace at grade
time — call earlier steps by name; you do not import them. Run
`uv run python projects.py diffusion-ddpm-from-scratch` (or the outline drawer) to see all signatures.
title: Build a Diffusion Model (DDPM) from Scratch

parts.title: Noise Schedule
parts.description: Build the linear beta schedule and the alpha / cumulative-alpha buffers that define the forward diffusion.

parts.title: Forward Diffusion Process
parts.description: Noise a clean sample to an arbitrary timestep in one shot, and draw random timesteps + noise for training.

parts.title: Time Embedding & Denoiser
parts.description: Sinusoidal timestep embeddings and a small MLP that predicts the noise added to a noisy sample.

parts.title: Training Objective
parts.description: The simple noise-prediction MSE loss, a single optimization step, and the training loop.

parts.title: DDPM Sampling
parts.description: Reverse the diffusion one stochastic step at a time, from pure noise back to a sample.

parts.title: DDIM Sampling
parts.description: Deterministic accelerated sampling and an end-to-end generation helper.

steps.name: linear_beta_schedule
steps.doc:
Build the variance (beta) schedule as a linear ramp over T diffusion steps.

Return torch.linspace(beta_start, beta_end, T): a length-T tensor with betas[0]=beta_start and betas[-1]=beta_end, evenly spaced.

steps.name: compute_alphas
steps.doc: Compute per-step alphas as one minus the betas.

steps.name: compute_alpha_bars
steps.doc: Compute cumulative alpha products (alpha_bar) along the time axis.

steps.name: gather_at_timesteps
steps.doc: Index a 1-D schedule buffer at the given timesteps and reshape to (B,1) for broadcasting.

steps.name: sqrt_alpha_bar_terms
steps.doc: Return sqrt(alpha_bar_t) and sqrt(1 - alpha_bar_t) gathered at timesteps t.

steps.name: q_sample
steps.doc: Apply the closed-form forward noising to produce x_t from x0 and noise at timesteps t.

steps.name: sample_timesteps_and_noise
steps.doc: Draw random integer timesteps in [0, T) and standard-normal noise shaped like x0.

steps.name: sinusoidal_time_embedding
steps.doc:
Map integer timesteps to Transformer-style sinusoidal feature vectors.

Let half=dim//2 and freqs=exp(-(arange(half)/max(half,1))*log(10000)). With args = t[:,None].float()*freqs (shape (B,half)), return a (B,dim) float32 tensor whose even columns (0::2) are sin(args) and odd columns (1::2) are cos(args) (so t=0 gives sin 0, cos 1).

steps.name: init_denoiser_params
steps.doc:
Initialize MLP weights/biases mapping data+time features to a data-dim output.

Return a list of (W, b) tuples, one per layer, for sizes [data_dim+time_dim] + list(hidden) + [data_dim]. Each W has shape (in_dim, out_dim) initialized as randn*0.1; each b has shape (out_dim,) initialized to zeros; both float32 with requires_grad=True. Seed with torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed) for determinism.

steps.name: denoiser_mlp_forward
steps.doc: Run the MLP forward with ReLU after every layer except the linear last.

steps.name: predict_noise
steps.doc: Predict the noise added to x_t at timestep t using the time-conditioned denoiser.

steps.name: diffusion_loss
steps.signature: diffusion_loss(params, x0, alpha_bars, T, time_dim, generator=None)
steps.doc: Compute the DDPM training loss: MSE between the denoiser's predicted noise and the true noise.

steps.name: denoiser_train_step
steps.signature: denoiser_train_step(params, x0, alpha_bars, T, time_dim, lr, generator=None)
steps.doc: Run one SGD step on the diffusion loss and return the scalar loss value before the update.

steps.name: train_denoiser
steps.signature: train_denoiser(params, x0, alpha_bars, T, time_dim, lr, n_steps, generator=None)
steps.doc: Train the denoiser for n_steps on a fixed batch and return the list of per-step losses.

steps.name: predict_x0_from_noise
steps.doc: Recover the predicted clean sample x0 from a noisy x_t and the noise.

steps.name: posterior_mean
steps.signature: posterior_mean(x0, x_t, t, betas, alphas, alpha_bars)
steps.doc:
Compute the mean of the DDPM posterior q(x_{t-1}|x_t,x0).

Gather beta_t, alpha_t, alpha_bar_t at t and alpha_bar_prev at t-1 (use alpha_bar_prev=1 where t==0). Return coef0*x0 + coeft*x_t, where coef0 = beta_t*sqrt(alpha_bar_prev)/(1-alpha_bar_t) and coeft = (1-alpha_bar_prev)*sqrt(alpha_t)/(1-alpha_bar_t); shape (B,D).

steps.name: ddpm_sample_step
steps.signature: ddpm_sample_step(params, x_t, t, betas, alphas, alpha_bars, time_dim, generator=None)
steps.doc:
Take one reverse DDPM denoising step from x_t to x_{t-1}.

t is a python int; broadcast it to a (B,) tensor. Predict noise, recover x0_hat via predict_x0_from_noise, then mean=posterior_mean(...). If t==0 return mean. Else return mean + sqrt(posterior_variance)*z with z~randn(generator), posterior_variance = beta_t*(1-alpha_bar_{t-1})/(1-alpha_bar_t).

steps.name: ddpm_sample_loop
steps.signature: ddpm_sample_loop(params, shape, betas, alphas, alpha_bars, time_dim, generator=None)
steps.doc: Run the full reverse DDPM chain from pure noise x_T down to x_0.

steps.name: ddim_sample_step
steps.signature: ddim_sample_step(params, x_t, t, t_prev, alpha_bars, time_dim)
steps.doc:
Take one deterministic (eta=0) DDIM reverse step from timestep t to t_prev.

t and t_prev are python ints. Predict eps, get x0_hat via predict_x0_from_noise. Let ab_prev = alpha_bar at t_prev, or 1 when t_prev<0. Return sqrt(ab_prev)*x0_hat + sqrt(1-ab_prev)*eps (shape (B,D)); deterministic, no added noise (eta=0).

steps.name: ddim_sample_loop
steps.doc:
Generate samples by iterating deterministic DDIM steps over evenly-spaced timesteps.

Build ts = torch.linspace(T-1, 0, n_steps).round().long().tolist(); start x=torch.randn(shape). For each index i with timestep t, set t_prev = ts[i+1] if it exists else -1, and x = ddim_sample_step(params, x, t, t_prev, alpha_bars, time_dim). Return the final x of shape `shape`.

steps.name: generate_samples
steps.signature: generate_samples(params, n_samples, data_dim, betas, alphas, alpha_bars, time_dim, method='ddpm', ddim_steps=None, generator=None)
steps.doc: Generate samples from the trained denoiser using either DDPM or DDIM sampling.
